status: Frozen replication design before collection/evaluation of November games; internal freeze, not external preregistration
selection: Within each available date, first four valid closed NBA moneyline games by scheduled tip and slug. Use all if fewer than four; no backfilling or outcome/activity/volume thresholds.
metadata_selection: Existing candidate metadata yields 34 games across nine dates; no candidate games available November 3; November 5 has two. This is the API-discovered sample, not proof of exhaustive listings.
training: The original eight and October 28-30 later sample (32 total). All features/scalers/estimators fit on those games only; no tuning on November outcomes.
forward_price: Next-minute signed log-odds change; original market baseline, counts-only augmentation, full original social augmentation. Five-minute price sensitivity.
forward_volume: Next-five-minute log(1+USDC volume); persistence and market baseline versus social augmentations. Fifteen-minute sensitivity.
reverse_attention: Next-five-minute log(1+sum of query-side post counts), posting-history/game-state baseline versus price-only and broader market augmentations. Fifteen-minute sensitivity.
estimators: Ridge alpha=1 primary, OLS sensitivity, training-only standardization. Nonnegative volume/attention predictions clipped to zero.
timing: Original query sort-time convention plus conservative both-timestamps-confirmed subset for forward experiments. Exclude final partial minute using exact ESPN final timestamps in all tasks.
metrics: Pooled and equal-game RMSE, MAE, paired per-game errors; game and date cluster bootstrap sensitivity intervals, seed473 and 10000 draws.
claims: Observational prediction and replication; no causal or executable-profit claim. Repeated teams and multiple endpoints constrain inference. Report every specification rather than select a winner.
quality: Human relevance/novelty review and injury-source verification remain outstanding. No unvalidated cleaned-news feature is introduced as ground truth.
